notes.title: Version 1.5 Release - Night Time Hangouts + Ken's DLC is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36654418/9f9d14a603d9486020887200bc480a1e77950881.jpg[/img]

The long awaited update is now here!

[h1]Night Time Phase[/h1]

With this new update, Tomoki is now able to go out at night other than the afternoons.

The following are things you need to know for the Night Time Phase:
[list]
[*] You are able to 'hangout' with characters, allowing more ways to increase the affection of characters.
[*] The special heart events for the main bachelors cannot be triggered during the Night Phase.
[*] [DLC Characters] in the future will be having their heart events happen at night only, so you can focus on DLC characters in this new phase. 
[*] You can still visit shops at this time.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36654418/7d49025404d850343deaa70d8d1e97d9a8fd2a11.jpg[/img]

[h1]Doctor Ken: A Healthy Alternative[/h1]

Ken's DLC is now available which unlocks him as a character you can potentially have a casual fling with. 

[b]Flings [/b]are similar to the other character interactions with the following properties:
[list]
[*] You can trigger their special events only at night.
[*] They can be given gifts and you can hangout with them at any phase.
[*] You can start interacting as soon as they appear in Morningwood.
[*] They DO NOT affect your ending in the game, so have casual fun responsibly.
[/list]

Get it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1931830/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36654418/c0ce5c2a3f559dc4104e268cd73e584fe4f56c28.jpg[/img]

[h1]Free DLC: Starter Item Pack[/h1]

As a treat, you can make your run easier with a free item pack of every item along with a set of special Promised Rings! They're sure to be loved by your man of choice.

Get it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1928770/

At your service!

notes.title: Upcoming DLC Announcement + Another Update
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Valentines, everyone![/h1]
It's been almost two years since we released the game already, and we're eternally grateful you enjoyed the game.

After going through feedback and undergoing some tests, we plan to release a new update soon and even DLC soon!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vHpM3Ig.jpg[/img]

[h2]Expanded schedule at Night [/h2]
With the new update, you'll be able to hang out with the bachelors to improve their affection. You can only trigger heart events during the daytime hours though.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2QkUu5a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Free DLC: Promised Ring Set[/h2]
To make it easier for you, we will provide a free item set that includes one of each item to make your adventure much easier. If you feel it's a bit challenging, add it to your adventure!

[h2]Fling DLC #1 Doctor Ken[/h2]
With popular demand, Doctor Ken will be available as DLC in the near future. It's currently under testing, and we'll release it for everyone to use soon! Flings are a new set of heart events for NPCs, where once you install the DLC, you'll be able to date and bed some NPCs in the game! In this case, you trigger their events AT NIGHT only. Talk to the good Doctor and see what you learn about him and he just might reward you.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uJvtYE9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Upcoming Fling DLC, Sir Schwarz[/h2]
We're also working on Rald's father as a DLC soon! So keep track on our social media for that!

Notes:
[olist]
[*] All fling DLCs are planned to be priced at [b]$4.99[/b] each.
[*] As discussed in a previous post, we won't be implementing a separate file for mobile release. 
[/olist]

For further announcements on when the DLC will be available, follow us over on twitter --> [url=https://twitter.com/fullservicegame]@FullServiceGame[/url].

At your service!

notes.title: Android Version Releasing on September 27th
notes.content:
Hello there!

[h3]Mobile Release Details[/h3]
It took quite some time and a few challenges to scale down and make sure that the mobile version of the game would be ready. But here we are. The mobile version of the game will exclusively release on itch.io starting [b]September 27th, 2020[/b]. As we explained in [url=https://herculiongames.itch.io/full-service/devlog/140305/regarding-android-release]this devlog[/url], the retail price will just be for [b]$24.99[/b].

Releasing it on STEAM is currently not preferred for the mobile release, and we can't offer it as DLC there, so it will be a stand alone purchase. For more information on the reasons behind there, please read [url=https://herculiongames.itch.io/full-service/devlog/140305/regarding-android-release]this devlog[/url].

[h3]Free Copy for Backers[/h3]
As promised to the initial backers for the game, we can give you a key for the mobile version by sending us an a zendesk request on https://herculion.zendesk.com/hc/en-us. Please place your title as [b][MOBILE RELEASE][/b] to claim your key. When we say initial backers, we mean:

[list]
[*] You supported the game via Kickstarter
[*] You supported the game via purchasing the PreCopy in a convention
[*] You supported the game via the limited Paypal Backing Campaign
[*] This is not the same case as the [STEAM Release] for itchio purchasers.
[/list]

[h3]Will This Be On Google Play?[/h3]
Due to the nature of the game, we cannot release it on Google Play as it is and will require some censoring. So we cannot promise it to be on the App Store. Manual Installation will be required for you to play it.

--

We will also be introducing some bug fixes before that date, so keep watch on our devlogs on STEAM and itch.io for Changelogs once again. At your service!

notes.title: Emergency Fix: Fixing Full Completion Bug
notes.content:
Hello. 

There was an issue where a test file caused some users who updated the last build to find that they had completed the game entirely. This was an error from the deployment of the build. We have rolled back the build and are deploying a new one with the fixes. 

If any users wish to delete the progress of the game without triggering achievements, [url=https://herculion.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/900000233883-How-do-I-delete-my-save-files-]you may delete your save files[/url]. it is important to delete the persistent save file if you want a clean start.

For those who managed to get all the achievements, we sincerely apologize for the issue happening. We cannot revoke achievements individually per account.

For those truly wanting to remove all achievements from their account, there are third-party programs that let you reset achievements. It is important to emphasize that neither us nor Valve endorse the use of those programs, as they may result in VAC bans. So please be cautious using third-party programs.

notes.title: Emergencial Update: Fix for "Achievement Not Registering" Bug
notes.content:
Hello there, Striker here. For those who don't know me, I am the programmer responsible for the coding and development of Full Service since February 2019.

I'm publishing this post to make you are currently aware of the update that was published a bit ago. That update fixed a bug in which no achievements registered at all in the game despite clearing the conditions for unlocking them. The cause of this bug was that some of the Ren'Py libraries packaged with the game that are responsible for managing the integration with Steam got corrupted, and weren't loading properly when the game was launched. The recent update fixed that and should, therefore, make those achievements obtainable for all players.

In case you have already cleared the conditions for any achievement(s) but didn't unlock it/them it due to the bug mentioned above, said achievement(s) should be unlocked upon launching the game. If this does not happen, try clearing its conditions again, and if even then you still can't unlock them, feel free to contact us at [url=https://herculion.zendesk.com/hc/en-us]our Zendesk[/url] so we can identify what went wrong. In fact, if you identify anything that seems to be a bug, typo or crash while you're playing the game, feel free to contact us that way. We will be fixing any reported bugs as fast as we can and we should be publishing new updates in a weekly to biweekly basis to patch them, except for potential cases in which gamebreaking bugs are found, in which case we'll be releasing an update as soon as humanly possible.

Thank you for supporting the game, and please enjoy Full Service to its fullest!
